name: Hinoe
source:
A mysterious youth who appears unexpectedly.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Suzaku of Heaven.
A smooth talker who likes women.
He's always composed and ready to help calmly deal with any dilemma.
He was interested in the protagonist who he knew was the Priestess and called out to her.

[Spoiler]Also known as Fujiwara no Tanzou, in charge of the navy of  Kumamo[/Spoiler]
